theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for B2B Engineering/Architectural)
theme_and_archetype.description: The design must feel like a high-end mobility consulting firm. No SaaS fluff, no soft gradients. Use sharp lines, strict grids, and generous negative space. It should look like an interactive architectural blueprint.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-light text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white

typography.requirements: MUST import Latin Extended character sets from Google Fonts to support Polish diacritics (ł, ś, ż, ć, ń, ó).

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The 'Control Room' grid. Strict, dense alignment. Elements should share borders to feel like a dashboard or control panel.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Generous spacing within sections (py-24 or py-32).
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border using border_subtle (#656b80 at 30% opacity) to create crisp, architectural section dividers.

logo.description: Brand Logo (Navy Background version). Best used on dark navy backgrounds.

hero_background.description: Aerial freeway at golden hour. MUST overlay with bg-[#0d2745]/70 (Deep Navy at 70% opacity) or a gradient overlay so white text remains readable and the brand color dominates the vibe.

project_map.description: EU project locations map. Branded in Navy/Cyan. Display prominently in the 'Where we operate' section.

components_and_interactions.scrolling: Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis (if supported) or CSS scroll-behavior: smooth for the single-page anchor links.
components_and_interactions.animations: Subtle fade-up (Framer Motion) on scroll for all sections. No chaotic bouncing. Sharp, professional easing (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
components_and_interactions.language_switcher: A crisp, technical toggle button in the navbar (PL | EN). Needs React state to drive translations across the page.
components_and_interactions.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Hover state: background shifts to pure #27aae1 (Cyan) and text to #0d2745 (Navy). Use 1px cyan borders for secondary buttons.
components_and_interactions.testing: MANDATORY: data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, language switcher).

1_Navbar.layout: Sticky top, z-50. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0d2745]/90 border-b border-[#656b80]/30.
1_Navbar.elements: Logo (left), Navigation links (center - About, Services, Map, Trainings, Contact), Language Switcher (right).

2_Hero.content: H1 Motto ('Planowanie zaczyna się tu' / 'Engineering starts here'), CTA Button ('Kontakt').

3_Stats_Strip.layout: Grid cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 border-y border-[#656b80]/30 bg-[#0a1e36]
3_Stats_Strip.styling: Numbers must use 'IBM Plex Mono' in text-4xl or 5xl, text-[#27aae1]. Labels in text-[#cbd5e1] text-sm.

4_About.styling: Asymmetric layout. One column text, the other column can be a stylized technical blank space or abstract structural grid.

5_Services.content: 6 Service Cards: Traffic Analyses, Modeling & Forecasting, Microsimulation, Traffic Surveys, Traffic Control, Advisory.
5_Services.styling: Strict 'Control Room' grid. border-collapse styling where cards share 1px borders. Hover: 1px border turns #27aae1, slight lift.

6_Where_We_Operate.content: Map caption: 'Gdzie działamy / Our actions', and the project_map image.
6_Where_We_Operate.styling: Map should be large, full width (max-w-5xl). Use an elegant thin 1px border around the image container.

7_PTV_Trainings.styling: Make the 'Certified PTV Trainer' text highly visible using a technical badge design (cyan border, mono text).

8_Footer.styling: Minimalist, huge footer typography for the 'Let's Talk' section. Left-aligned list of contact info.

translations_state_schema.instruction: Main agent must define a state dictionary for EN and PL languages to toggle smoothly. Copy must handle both.
